messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Fire Emblem 7: Blazing Blade-inspired remake in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Verify appearance using small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px); inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original, single-chapter tactical tribute called “The Blazing Blade,” set at Ashen Ford, with Lyn’s company facing bandits.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a self-contained playable game in `index.html`: tactical map, units, movement, combat forecasts, turn phases, enemy behavior, victory/defeat, responsive layout, and keyboard controls.
- JavaScript passed `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and inspected its page snapshot.

### Active
- Fix and verify the HTML structure: a duplicate `showResult` function appears after `</html>` at the file end; the function was also inserted before `startGame`, so remove the trailing duplicate.
- Exercise the game in-browser and capture/inspect a JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
